tests.formula.syntax: Test codes in brackets [ALT], numbers, + - * / ^ ( ), comparisons < <= > >= = <>, ROUND(x, n), IF(c, a, b), MIN, MAX, ABS. Patient variables: @AGE (age in completed years) and @FEMALE (1 for a female, 0 for a male); the result waits while either is unknown. Example: 175 * [CREA] ^ -1.154 * @AGE ^ -0.203 * IF(@FEMALE, 0.742, 1).

compatible.title: Compatible sample conditions
compatible.subtitle: Conditions whose tests share the sample of another condition of the same sample type when both are in one visit.
compatible.hint: Within one processing unit and sample type, a condition that merges into another joins that condition's sample when it is in the same visit; the sample keeps the other condition's name. Alone, the condition keeps its own sample.
compatible.drawerHint: For each condition choose its own sample or the condition whose sample it joins. A condition that others join cannot join another one, and only active conditions can be joined.
compatible.fixRules: Correct the marked conditions before saving.
